summary: An original compact sci-fi laser pistol, 0.20 m long (a subcompact sidearm, the size of a real compact 9 mm)… joints trigger, power_cell; options finish, energy; sockets socket_muzzle, socket_grip, grip_r, grip_l, sight, muzzle.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.laser_pistol_compact or place "prefab": "laser_pistol_compact" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), viewmodel().
